possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. possible_risks.justification: Training data is named as MaziyarPanahi/truthy-dpo-v0.1-axolotl but the card gives no origin, ownership, curation, or verification details for that dataset.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
